Lemma
[Duhamel's principle with boundary] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0422 1. appe:1.13\group Heat Kernels

For a compact manifold with boundary, the closed-manifold Duhamel identity acquires the boundary flux term \[ \int _{t_1}^{t_2}\! \int _{\partial M}\left[-(\partial _ u A)B+A(\partial _ u B) ight]d\sigma ds. \]
